paragraphs: In [Eruvin 58a](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.59a.9), R' Nachman said, “Such as the town of Natuzai.” [Rashi](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashi_on_Eruvin.59a.9.6) explains: the town of that man.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Supplied נתוזאי differs from older machine נתזואי. The name remains provisionally transliterated without identifying a person or a town beyond Hyman’s report.
Hyman gives 58a. The linked folio is 59a, where Rav Nachman cites דיסקרתא דנתזואי as an example of a town. Rashi’s gloss explains it as that man’s town. Hyman’s Hebrew spells the name נתוזאי.
